summary:
Oct  


Well, I finally found your address. We moved, and in doing so mislaid or lost many of our addresses. This is why I haven’t written, especially to thank you for the plaque. Thank you, and forgive, forgive; we still have box after box unopened, because Tessa had her baby, a little boy named Christopher, and we have done nothing but take care of him—its been a fulltime job (born July 25th). We’ve also had our ups and downs, here in the new apartment. We bought a car and everything went wrong with it... .we’ve been super broke, but now we’ve sold a book (DO ANDROIDS DREAM OF ELECTRIC SHEEP?) to the movies—to United Artists. So I got a letter from my agent today reading, “Very shortly, these financial hardships will be over.” Also, I did two days of filming for French TV, mostly at Disneyland, and the exhaustion and overexcitement sent me to bed with the flu, three weeks ago. I went from being before the cam­ era to lying in bed like a sick little boy, unable to go outdoors: the cyclic story of my life. 

But the important thing is that Christopher is healthy and happy, unaware that we are broke and in debt; he’s a handsome boy, and when we can get a pic­ ture we’ll send it. Also, I did an interview for Vertex magazine, issue #6, which will be out in December; it’s a hell of a good interview and I urge you to read it. Should have several pictures of me with it. I’ve thought about you guys a lot... we will soon, when the money comes in ($2,000 option money on the movie sale...
